description.zh-CN: 白名单命令执行：默认仅 ls / cat / grep / git status，全部需审批
description.en-US: Whitelisted command execution: ls / cat / grep / git status by default, all approved

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Run ONE whitelisted command and return {command, program, exit_code, success, timed_out, truncated, stdout, stderr}. Only a small allowlist is permitted (ls, cat, grep, git status; more via host config); destructive commands (rm, sudo, curl, ...) are on a permanent denylist and refused without approval; pipes, command substitution and shell metacharacters are rejected — pass a single simple command. The tool itself is Irreversible and requires user approval.

command.description: single simple command, e.g. "git status"; no pipes/semicolons/backticks

cwd.description: optional working directory (absolute path, must exist)
